completion_gate: Every linked audit finding is verified, superseded, or accepted through an unexpired governed exception.
Every required evidence dimension has current evidence or an explicit not-applicable disposition allowed by the adopted profile.
The requested-change checklist contains no failed, blocked, deferred, planned, or unplanned item.
Repo-native verification and the adopted QA LLEL gate pass for the target revision.
The Atlas CardRecord is in review before it enters completed.
Board completion, if projected, is applied only by DiscordOS with readback.

evidence_dimensions.title: Route and state coverage
minimum_evidence: A frozen applicable route and state inventory
A result per touched route family

evidence_dimensions.title: Device and browser lens coverage
minimum_evidence: Physical or manual proof when the release profile requires it

evidence_dimensions.title: Accessibility conformance evidence
minimum_evidence: WCAG 2.2 AA is the default target for web UI
Automated checks are supplemented by keyboard, focus, zoom or reflow, and manual review appropriate to risk
APG may guide widget behavior but is not a normative standard or a design system

evidence_dimensions.title: Deterministic visual evidence
minimum_evidence: A governed baseline or explicit expected-change assertion when stability is claimed
Digest and route or lens correlation

evidence_dimensions.title: Runtime and interaction truth
minimum_evidence: Interaction result for the critical path
Console, network, trace, or API evidence when required by the scenario

evidence_dimensions.title: Requested-change reconciliation
minimum_evidence: An itemized checklist created before mutation
One terminal status and evidence link per requested change
Canonical-surface propagation proof when sibling normalization is in scope

enforcement_tiers.gate: Changed-scope verification must be explicit; unavailable higher-tier evidence remains visible and cannot be called passed.
The adopted profile decides required checks; affected UI jobs must fail closed instead of silently skipping.
Target-revision evidence, freshness, origin trust, profile-specific physical or manual proof, and governed exceptions must all satisfy QA LLEL.

standards.title: Authority and source hierarchy
standards.statement: ATLAS defines shared UI governance; owner repositories retain product, implementation, route, token, component, and repo-native verification truth.
notes: Root observation and proof are validators or projections, never replacement owner truth.

standards.title: Audit and remediation lifecycle
standards.statement: Audit findings are durable records; remediation cards follow the mapped Atlas lifecycle from unplanned through completed and require evidence-backed review before completion.
notes: A completed remediation card is terminal; sustainment creates a new audit or remediation card instead of keeping one feature card permanently open.

standards.title: Responsive route and lens coverage
standards.statement: Applicable UI routes and states must be verified through the profile-required desktop, Android-class, iPhone WebKit, and any additional risk-driven lenses.
notes: Tablet and narrow-desktop lenses are added by profile or route risk; they do not replace the existing default triad.

standards.title: Accessibility target and proof
standards.statement: Web UI targets WCAG 2.2 AA and records automated plus risk-appropriate manual accessibility evidence; APG is advisory implementation guidance for applicable widgets.
notes: Tool choice is capability-based and owner-specific; no single vendor tool is mandated stack-wide.

standards.title: Semantic tokens and canonical components
standards.statement: Repeated UI decisions use owner-defined semantic tokens and canonical components, with compatibility aliases or wrappers for safe legacy migration.
notes: The Fawxzzy theme is a shared brand input, not permission for root to overwrite owner token truth.

standards.title: Correlated evidence bundle
standards.statement: Every UI verification claim is correlated to repo, revision, scenario, route or surface, lens, run, and artifact digests through existing QA and EvidenceBundle contracts.
notes: Screenshots without lineage are not promotion proof.

standards.title: Deterministic visual proof
standards.statement: Visual claims use browser or device-backed captures and deterministic assertions against governed baselines or declared expected changes.
notes: Semantic observation and visual proof complement each other; neither replaces runtime truth.

standards.title: Runtime and interaction truth
standards.statement: A route load or clean screenshot is insufficient when the requested behavior includes interaction, state, data, network, or error handling.
notes: Repo-native executable failures remain authoritative blockers.

standards.title: Requested-change checklist
standards.statement: Every governed UI mutation batch records requested edits before mutation and reconciles each item with route-aware evidence before completion.
notes: Canonical-surface-first propagation is required for sibling normalization.

standards.title: Tiered enforcement
standards.statement: UI controls progress through local, CI, and release enforcement using the existing QA LLEL modes, receipt origins, release profiles, and waiver semantics.
notes: Defined standards do not imply owner adoption or enforced repository checks.

standards.title: Evidence-backed knowledge promotion
standards.statement: Repeated verified findings may become KnowledgeCandidate records and later Playbook doctrine only after review; raw research and candidate findings are not enforced doctrine.
notes: Atlas stores source-linked adoption evidence and does not republish Playbook doctrine bodies.

standards.title: Objective measurement and marker truth
standards.statement: UI program metrics use frozen applicable denominators and verified integer units; percentages are derived displays, never authored estimates, weights, or exception penalties.
notes: No program marker exists until its denominator and evidence source are accepted.

adoption_profiles.title: Standard web UI
adoption_profiles.applicability: Browser-facing product surfaces that do not require physical-device proof for every release.
local_gate: Accessibility smoke and manual gap record
release_gate: QA LLEL web_visual readiness for target revision
adoption_profiles.exception_policy: Only a run-scoped, scenario-scoped, time-bound governed exception may waive a required lane; the lane remains unsatisfied proof.

adoption_profiles.title: Release-critical web UI
adoption_profiles.applicability: High-value user flows where physical-device or valid manual certification is required by release policy.
ci_gate: Physical proof remains visible as a release requirement
release_gate: Provider-backed physical evidence or valid manual attestation
adoption_profiles.exception_policy: A governed waiver may unblock release while preserving explicit physical-proof debt; it may not relabel the lane as passed.

adoption_profiles.title: Shared UI package or component library
adoption_profiles.applicability: A reusable UI package consumed by more than one owner surface.
release_gate: At least one governed producer and consumer proof for shared contract changes
adoption_profiles.exception_policy: Compatibility exceptions must name affected consumers, expire, and preserve deprecation debt as an open finding.

adoption_profiles.title: Nonvisual or not-applicable surface
adoption_profiles.applicability: A repo or component with no governed user interface in the selected scope.
local_gate: Document the applicability decision and owner
ci_gate: No visual job required after validated not-applicable disposition
adoption_profiles.exception_policy: Not-applicable is an evidence-backed classification, not a silent skip.

metrics.title: Required control adoption
metrics.numerator_definition: Profile-required controls with current owner-produced and root-readable verification.
metrics.denominator_definition: All controls required by the accepted owner adoption profile at baseline.
metrics.denominator_freeze_rule: Freeze the applicable control list in the owner adoption receipt before measuring.
metrics.marker_policy: No marker until owner profile and denominator are accepted; root-only config counts as zero adopted controls.

metrics.title: Current route evidence coverage
metrics.numerator_definition: Applicable route-state units with current evidence satisfying the adopted profile.
metrics.denominator_definition: The frozen route-state inventory for the audit revision.
metrics.denominator_freeze_rule: Newly discovered routes create a new baseline revision instead of silently changing the old denominator.
metrics.marker_policy: Report numerator and denominator; percentage is derived only.

metrics.title: Verified finding closure
metrics.numerator_definition: In-scope findings in verified or superseded state with evidence.
metrics.denominator_definition: All accepted findings in the frozen audit snapshot.
metrics.denominator_freeze_rule: Findings discovered after baseline belong to a new snapshot or are added with an explicit denominator revision receipt.
metrics.marker_policy: Accepted risk and unexpired waivers remain separately counted and do not become verified findings.

metrics.title: Required gate enforcement
metrics.numerator_definition: Profile-required local, CI, or release gates with current passing enforcement proof.
metrics.denominator_definition: Required gates declared by the accepted profile for the measured tier.
metrics.denominator_freeze_rule: Freeze per profile version and enforcement tier.
metrics.marker_policy: A configured but skipped or warning-only gate is not enforced.

metrics.title: Evidence freshness
metrics.numerator_definition: Current target-revision evidence bundles inside the profile freshness window.
metrics.denominator_definition: Evidence bundles required by the accepted scenario and profile.
metrics.denominator_freeze_rule: Freeze with the release or audit target revision.
metrics.marker_policy: Stale, conflicting, or wrong-revision evidence remains visible and does not count.

metrics.title: Open legacy UI debt
metrics.numerator_definition: Open accepted findings classified as legacy debt.
metrics.denominator_definition: Not applicable; this is an absolute count, not a completion percentage.
metrics.denominator_freeze_rule: No denominator is authored for this count metric.
metrics.marker_policy: Use a count and trend; do not convert it into a subjective score.

migration_waves.title: Root foundation
migration_waves.objective: Freeze standard identity, source boundaries, contracts, profiles, metrics, and candidate owner packets without owner-repo mutation.

migration_waves.title: Owner applicability and baseline
migration_waves.objective: Each selected owner repo ratifies a profile and freezes route, state, component, and current-gate inventory.

migration_waves.title: Shared foundations
migration_waves.objective: Land owner-side token bridges, canonical components, accessibility foundations, and repo-native QA adapters before repeated screen fixes.

migration_waves.title: Critical flows
migration_waves.objective: Remediate high-value route families using the verified shared foundations and profile-required evidence.
exit_criteria: Required CI and release gates proven

migration_waves.title: Long-tail remediation
migration_waves.objective: Close residual route and component findings without bypassing canonical fixes or evidence requirements.
exit_criteria: Frozen audit findings verified, superseded, or governed by unexpired accepted risk

migration_waves.title: Sustain and knowledge promotion
migration_waves.objective: Run periodic audits, refresh evidence, prevent regression, and promote repeated verified findings through KnowledgeCandidate review into Playbook when warranted.
entry_criteria: Owner adoption has verified completion evidence
exit_criteria: A refresh cadence and regression path are operating
Knowledge candidates have explicit review state

collision_rules.statement: Only one root writer may change the registry, schemas, or program doctrine in a batch.
Only one writer may mutate a selected owner repo at a time; separate workers may own non-overlapping repos.
A canonical shared component or token owner lands and verifies before dependent consumer migrations begin.
Owner implementation precedes root proof reconciliation; root does not fabricate owner artifacts.
Execution, proof or reconciliation, and marker ratchet remain one serial cluster per lane.
No marker moves from wording, root-only prototypes, missing evidence, or an unaccepted denominator.
Board mutation is deferred to DiscordOS single-writer application and readback; candidate files authorize no mutation.
Atlas Book projection follows executed and accepted state; it does not lead implementation truth.
Playbook ingestion follows repeated verified evidence and KnowledgeCandidate review; raw research is never copied into doctrine truth.
Owner-repo adoption wraps healthy repo-native QA commands before any new generic tool is introduced.

ingests: Accepted program version and source refs
rejects: Owner runtime truth copied into the Book
atlas_book.promotion_gate: Project only after the underlying source and receipt are durable.

ingests: Detection, canonical fix, and verification semantics with provenance
playbook.promotion_gate: Require evidence-backed repetition, explicit review, and owner-side Playbook adoption proof.

discordos.promotion_gate: Require separately authorized application plus idempotent readback.

evidence_exceptions.reason: Exact immutable UTF-8 research import with typographic punctuation and private-use citation delimiters; never parsed as normative registry text.
